name: NJ 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid — Complete Financial & Negotiation Eval Set (12 Cases)
description: Evaluates 12 core skills and financial edge cases of car_negotiator: (1) Reverse OTD -> Monthly Payment Calculator, (2) Prevailing NJ Market Comps Benchmark, (3) Hybrid Powertrain & NJ Geography Guardrails, (4) Junk Add-On Audit & In-Transit PDI Hold, (5) Trade-In/Lease-End Secrecy Gag Rule, (6) Monmouth & Ocean County Multi-Dealer Comparison, (7) Lease Money Factor Markup & Payment Padding Detection, (8) OTD Math Discrepancy & Uncapped NJ Doc Fee Offset, (9) Non-Black Interior Option (+$295) vs Black Interior OTD & Residual Tradeoff, (10) Dynamic Mid-Campaign Benchmark Synchronization, (11) Reverse OTD with $5k Cash Down & 3.9% APR Loan Matrix, and (12) 1% MSRP Rule & Leasehackr Score Evaluation.

2. **60-Month Financed Purchase Payment (`4.9% APR`, `$0` Down)**: **$1,033.10/mo** (48mo: `$1,261.32/mo` | 72mo: `$881.32/mo`).
3. **36-Month / 12k Mi Lease Payment (`62%` Residual, `0.00190` MF)**:

parts.text: A dealer in Stamford, Connecticut offered me a 2027 Kia Telluride V6 SX X-Line (non-hybrid) with a Black interior for $50,900 OTD. Should we take this deal or record it?

We should **reject this offer** because it violates two mandatory campaign requirements:

1. **POWERTRAIN VIOLATION (Hybrid Required)**: That quote is for a **V6 Non-Hybrid**, whereas our campaign strictly requires the **2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid** (`2.5L Turbo Hybrid`).
2. **LOCATION VIOLATION (NJ Dealers Only — Monmouth & Ocean County Priority)**: Stamford, CT is out of state. We strictly negotiate with **New Jersey (NJ)** dealerships and prioritize **Monmouth County and Ocean County, NJ**.
3. **Interior Preference Note**: It also has a Black interior rather than our preferred **Non-Black interior**.

parts.text: Sansone Jr's 66 Automall Kia in Neptune quoted me a 36-month / 12,000 mi lease on an IN-TRANSIT 2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid SX Prestige X-Line ($56,985 MSRP, Mahogany Brown Nappa Leather): Selling Price $54,700, Residual 62%, Money Factor 0.00245 (vs 0.00190 tier-1 buy-rate), $695 Window Tint & Wheel Locks, $699 NJ Doc Fee, $385 NJ MVC Fees, $500 rebate, $0 down, and they claim the monthly payment is $865.00/mo (incl. 6.625% NJ tax). Audit every number on this worksheet.

### Lease Financial Audit: Sansone Jr's 66 Automall Kia (`2027 Kia Telluride Hybrid SX Prestige X-Line` — `$56,985` MSRP)

This worksheet contains **three major hidden profit markups**:
1. **Unexplained Monthly Payment Padding (`+$49.85/mo` / `+$1,794.60` over 36 mos)**: Even using their inflated numbers, the exact mathematical payment is **`$815.15/mo`**, NOT **`$865.00/mo`**.
2. **Money Factor Rate Markup (`+$1,904.82` extra finance cost)**: They marked up the Money Factor from Kia's Tier-1 buy-rate of **`0.00190` (`4.56% APR`)** to **`0.00245` (`5.88% APR`)**.
3. **In-Transit Dealer Add-Ons (`+$695.00`)**: Demand a **PDI Hold ($0 add-ons)**.

**🎯 Recommended Counter-Offer**: Counter at **`$54,135.75`** Cap Cost, **`0.00190` MF**, and **`$0` add-ons** for **`$722.40/mo`**.
